title: WLine boundary point preservation across endpoint sampling, periodic seam insertion, and special-vertex registration
domain: OCCT geometric intersection before Boolean result assembly
scope_statement: Preserve correct boundary/intersection points and endpoint parameters in IntPatch WLine output as curved endpoints are sampled, periodic-equivalent points are handled near a full-period seam, and special vertices are registered during analytic-line conversion.

members.role: Endpoint sampling: refine a curved intersection endpoint when its tangent differs from the neighboring chord direction.
members.origin_evidence: Upstream fix 7eb3580b7995bbeb9ffbc501ec46c9d3a4ad611a, dated 2018-09-01; exact original/neighborhood/regression and baseline/reference evidence are already locked in NG-04T-v1. Reuse the same issue version only because the proposed source is the same locked NG-04T source.

members.role: Periodic seam insertion: avoid recording a boundary point as a distinct WLine point when its surface parameter is periodic-equivalent over an almost-full-period range.
members.origin_evidence: Upstream fix dccf86756104f107a2302a99a5f883bff2a62d54, dated 2020-06-18; upstream lowalgos/intss/bug31602 and exact embedded BREP are available. Version 2 is required to bind this issue to the proposed NG-04T source tree; same-tree original replay is still required.

members.role: ALine-to-WLine conversion: register the special vertex parameter; adjacent boundary-tangency classification can also affect whether an intersection branch is retained.
members.origin_evidence: Upstream fix 492b09dcaec31a4076241c578118bea129e60d25, dated 2022-10-31; the exact inverse is the NG-04T locked baseline and its self-contained four-branch oracle fails there.

relationship_decision.shared_contract: correct boundary and endpoint-point data represented in WLine before downstream joining or Boolean assembly
relationship_decision.adjacency: Endpoint sampling and periodic seam handling determine which points enter a WLine; ALine conversion registers special-vertex parameters and neighboring boundary classification affects branch retention. These are adjacent producer-side contracts on the same intersection representation.
relationship_decision.limits: No common root cause, single helper, cross-issue causal chain, or unique first faulty hunk is asserted. M30082 and M31602 touch the same implementation file through distinct triggers. M32850 also changes boundary-tangency handling and its first responsible hunk remains unknown. Group distinctness comes from its member set, including M31602 in place of M30202 in NG-04T-v1.

issue_unit_deduplication: Three distinct Mantis issue units; no findings, migration tickets, or PRs are counted as extra members.

baseline_plan.derivation: Historical derivation: exact reverse of the official M32850 fix from locked anchor d37d3beb3d8e563f66f189e1de23dd102d118c4d; the NG-04T-v1 baseline build/results were prior evidence. NG-05T-v1 current baseline evidence is recorded in source_runs/baseline/manifest.json.

known_members.M30082: fails its numeric endpoint-tolerance oracle on this tree
known_members.M32850: fails its four-intersection-branch oracle on this tree

baseline_plan.verified_gate: PASS: all nine baseline categories are archived on the locked source tree; eight semantic geometry failures and one pass, with all three selected member originals failing and no infrastructure/runtime errors. See source_runs/baseline/manifest.json.

reference_plan.candidate_fix: Compose only the official M30082, M31602, and M32850 source fixes on the locked baseline. Exclude the M30202 hunk from the NG-04T reference; do not infer compatibility from the complete NG-04T patch.
reference_plan.required_checks: all three members original, neighborhood, and regression must pass on the combined reference tree.
reference_plan.verified_gate: PASS: selected reference patch built from locked baseline artifacts and all nine original/neighborhood/regression checks passed. This is an incremental target rebuild, not a clean from-source build. See source_runs/reference/manifest.json and reference_build_receipt.json.

cross_group_relationship.NG-04T-v1: shares M30082 and M32850 but replaces M30202 with M31602; distinct issue set and new suite/group are required.
cross_group_relationship.NG-04R-v4: shares M30082 and M31602 but replaces M30202 with M32850; same B-boundary neighborhood, separately evaluated on this source.

decision: Independent scope review, same-tree baseline, nine-case reference differential, isolated framework replay, negative controls, formal integration, post-integration snapshot audit, and final independent delivery review all passed. NG-05T-v1 is formally accepted.

pre_review.result: The B-boundary scope has concrete adjacency across WLine endpoint sampling, periodic seam-equivalent point insertion, and special-vertex parameter registration; member substitution makes a distinct three-issue group rather than an alias.
pre_review.limits: At the pre-execution scope-review stage this reviewer had not established M31602 same-tree failure or combined-reference compatibility. Those gates were subsequently verified in the current NG-05T-v1 evidence; this scope-only review is not the final delivery review.
